title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter full trip/party amounts in euros (€) consistently; no flight, hotel, meal, fare, ticket, or reimbursement amount has been assumed. Bus and travel-card prices are now published and verified on the transport page if you want a benchmark for the transport rows; the only hotel-side figure with an official basis is the €1.50-per-night eco-contribution for guests aged 18+.

records.name: Flights — all travelers
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Optional line only for charges separately shown on the confirmed hotel invoice. The 2026 MTA guideline PDF lists €1.50 per night for each guest aged 18+ at the start of the visit, capped at €22.50 per person per visit, and separately disclosed on a fiscal receipt. The MTA webpage also has a “15-Night Threshold” sentence about charges on nights exceeding fifteen; the two official texts are not clearly reconciled for a short stay. If six nights are billable under the PDF’s per-night rule, €9 per eligible adult is conditional arithmetic only, not the traveler’s confirmed amount. Do not duplicate charges already in the accommodation total.
records.notes: The 2026 MTA guidelines PDF read 11 October states the nightly rate, age test, €22.50 cap and separate receipt disclosure: https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . The MTA service page was also read directly 11 October and separately says charges apply to nights that “exceeded fifteen (15) nights”: https://mta.com.mt/services/environmental-contribution/ . Do not infer how that wording applies to a short stay; see OQ-23/OQ-25 and ask AX ODYCY/MTA. The six-night calculation is conditional only. Actual billable nights, guest ages and invoice amount are unknown; nothing is prefilled.
records.price range: MTA guideline: €1.50 per night per eligible guest, cap €22.50 per person; short-stay treatment of the MTA webpage’s 15-night wording remains open. €9 for six billable nights is conditional arithmetic only.

records.name: Local buses / travel cards
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the total for the travel card, individual bus fares, or other public-transit purchases actually planned. Two published prices are usable as planning inputs, not as a trip quote: a day-route single at €2.50 (summer row) or €2.00 (winter row), and a travel card. On the published card terms, the €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day card is the only seven-day card whose own offer grid lists Day Routes, Night Routes, Airport Direct and Special Services, while the €25.00 Explore Adult 7-day card excludes tallinja Direct routes (the TD1 airport line). No journey count or card purchase is assumed.
records.notes: Fare page read in full 11 October 2026: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ . It dates its €2.00 winter single to 19 October 2025 – 13 June 2026 and prints no 2026/27 changeover date, so which single fare applies 13–19 October 2026 stays open — budget from the card table, or confirm the single on boarding. Published card terms: €19.00 for 12 shareable Single Day Journeys (Night Routes and Airport Direct cost 2 journeys each; valid 6 months from first use); €21.00 Explore Flex 4-day and €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day, both listing Day Routes, Night Routes, Airport Direct and Special Services; €25.00 Explore Adult 7-day (excludes tallinja Direct Routes; includes select Special Services); €7.00 Explore Child 7-day. A €50 fine applies without a valid ticket. Sales points include the Buġibba Terminal, the closest listed office to Qawra: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/office-and-ticket-machine/ . See getting-around.html#mpt-fares-cards and the transport records `mpt-fares-cards` and `mpt-seasonal-fare-window-2026`.
records.price range: Not set; published prices are comparisons. Which seasonal single applies 13–19 October 2026 is not published, and no card or journey count is assumed.

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel (bus out, return plan in)
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard — the venue's confirmed address; the attendee gate inside the site is still not published.
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.description: Track the actual event-day commute separately from general bus spending. The outbound leg is settled enough to plan: Route 186 runs from the Qawra seafront stops (Arznell 950, Luzzu 951, Qawra 952) to the Ta' Qali Stadium stop 6227, reaching the venue in time for even the 09:30 check-in. The return is NOT a bus trip on a full day: the venue days are listed to 22:30 (Wed 14, Thu 15) and 21:00 (Fri 16), the last listed Route 186 departure from the opposite-side Stadium stop 2194 toward Buġibba is 20:53, that direction serves no Il-Qawra stop, and no night route was verified to reach Ta' Qali or Attard. Budget the return as a taxi/ride-hailing journey unless MPT announces a TQ special service. Enter the amount only after deciding the date-specific route and the return plan.
records.notes: Published venue-day agenda from the event's own ticketing listing, read 11 October 2026: check-in 09:30 / games 10:30 / day to 22:30 on Wed 14 and Thu 15 October; check-in 14:00 / games 15:00 / day to 21:00 on Fri 16 October; Sat 17 and Sun 18 were not published (https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841). Route 186 stop chains, the 20:53 return departure and the Buġibba Bay 1 (2527) terminus are from the operator's route page: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/ . The walk to the attendee gate is unmeasured in both directions. Also check the operator's service updates for a possible TQ special event service and for the 17 October evening diversion: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ , and the live planner for the actual date: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/ . No taxi quote or gate detail is assumed here.
records.price range: Not set; the outbound is a published day-route single or covered by a card, the return is a live taxi/ride-hailing quote (or a €3.00 Special Services fare if a TQ service is announced).

records.name: Taxi / ride-hailing — plan the return for the five event nights
records.address: Not applicable — enter only trips you plan to take
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Not a contingency: this is the planned return for the event evenings, because no verified night bus serves Ta' Qali or Attard and the venue day is listed to 22:30 on two of the five days. Budget one return per event day attended (plus any daytime rides), then compare a live Bolt/eCabs quote against Transport Malta's published maximum meter rates. Quotes, availability and pickup location are trip-specific — no amount is prefilled.
records.notes: Provider information, not a fixed fare. Transport Malta publishes the regulated maximum meter rates (read 11 October 2026), but that page's footer says 'Page last updated: 06/04/2022', so treat the bands as possibly revised: https://www.transport.gov.mt/land/public-transport/other-public-transport/taxis-829 . Worked maxima at assumed distances — €12.40 (5 km), €19.40 (10 km), €25.90 (15 km), €30.90 (20 km) — are arithmetic, not quotes, and the Qawra-to-venue road distance was not measured. Ride-hailing prices are dynamic and not bound by the meter tariff. Check the app quote, the pickup pin, event-night availability and any venue pickup arrangements before relying on a ride: Bolt https://bolt.eu/en/cities/malta/ , eCabs https://ecabs.com.mt/ , Malta Taxi https://www.maltataxi.mt/ . See also the transport records `white-taxi-official-tariff`, `malta-ride-hailing-taxis` and `event-day-late-finish-return-gap`.
records.price range: Not set; live quote varies. Published meter maxima give a comparison ceiling only (≈ €12.40 at 5 km to ≈ €30.90 at 20 km, arithmetic at assumed distances — the road distance was not measured).

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: The event's own ticketing listing, read 11 October 2026, covers Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026 and labels the run 9:30 AM–10 PM. Visible agenda rows: Wed 14 and Thu 15 check-in 09:30 / games 10:30, each day listed to 22:30; Fri 16 check-in 14:00 / games 15:00, day listed to 21:00. The listing headline's 22:00 conflicts with the Wed/Thu rows extending to 22:30 — confirm the finish. Sat/Sun agenda entries did not render. The listing marks the event in-person and 18+.
records.description: If attending, enter only the confirmed ticket amount (the listing's price label reads Free) plus actual quoted or paid event-related transport, food or merchandise when known. The listing read 11 October shows “Free” with a “Reserve a spot” action for in-person 18+ attendance, but that does not establish current inventory, this traveller's own reservation, attendee-gate instructions, per-day validity/scanning, or that a zero personal admission expense is appropriate. No attendance, ride, meal or merchandise spend is assumed; leave budget and actual amounts blank until itinerary and booking details are supplied.
records.notes: Read 11 October 2026: the Hotspawn Eventbrite listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 shows BLAST Arena Studios Malta / MFCC South Gate National Stadium / ATD 4000 Attard, dates 14–18 October, the price label “Free”, a “Reserve a spot” action, a “Sales end soon” notice, and in-person 18+ highlights. Agenda entries for 14–16 October rendered; Saturday/Sunday did not, and the header's 22:00 conflicts with the Wed/Thu rows to 22:30. The nine FAQ answers (parking, per-day validity, daily scanning, food/drink, transfer and others) did not render. HLTV independently reported free tickets and linked to Eventbrite: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Thunderpick's organiser page gives the wider 12–19 October window: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . These sources describe the event and listing, not this traveller's booking or actual cost.
records.price range: Admission is listed as Free with a required reservation; current availability and this traveller's reservation status are not established. Leave planner amounts blank until confirmed — the real event-day cost here is the late return, tracked in `taxi-rideshare`.
